summary: Cubic Hermite spline interpolation of packed float pairs using 3DNow! SIMD. The factor t (low 32 bits of a6) is expanded to a packed 64-bit value, its powers t^2 and t^3 are computed, and the four standard Hermite basis functions are derived from them: h00 = 2t^3 - 3t^2 + 1, h10 = t^3 - 2t^2 + t, h01 = 3t^2 - 2t^3, h11 = t^3 - t^2. Each basis weight is duplicated across both float lanes (_m_punpckldq) and multiplied against one of the four packed control-point pairs a2-a5; the four products are summed and the full 64-bit packed result is written to a1[0]. Straight-line control flow, no branches. The packed scalar constants 1.0f, 2.0f, 3.0f come from the globals qword_5AF988, qword_5AF998, qword_5AF9A0.

operations.description: Build packed factor: v6 = _mm_cvtsi32_si64(a6) converts unsigned int t into a packed 64-bit value; v7 = t*t and v8 = t*t*t via _m_pfmul
h11 basis = t^3 - t^2 (v9 = v8 - v7 via _m_pfsub)
h10 basis = t^3 - 2*t^2 + t: v10 = v7 * packed 2.0f, then v15 = (v8 - v10) + v6; the 2.0f packed constant is read from either qword_5AF998 or qword_5AF9A0
h01 basis = 3*t^2 - 2*t^3: v13 = v7 * packed 3.0f, v12 = v8 * packed 2.0f, then v14 = v13 - v12; the 2.0f/3.0f packed constants are read from qword_5AF998 and qword_5AF9A0
h00 basis = 2*t^3 - 3*t^2 + 1: v16 = (v12 - v13) + packed 1.0f, where the packed 1.0f constant is read from qword_5AF988

Final blend: _m_punpckldq duplicates the low 32-bit float lane of each weight so the same weight applies to both floats of a control-point pair, then result = h00*dup(a2) + h10*dup(a3) + h01*dup(a4) + h11*dup(a5), accumulated with _m_pfmul and _m_pfadd over the packed 64-bit values of a2-a5
Write the full 64-bit packed interpolation result to the output at this+0x0 (a1->m64_u64), the only field accessed; overwrites both float lanes on every call
Return the output pointer a1 unchanged; 3DNow! MMX state is flushed via _m_femms both before and after the computation

clean_pseudocode: result = h00 * a2 + h10 * a3 + h01 * a4 + h11 * a5   // per-lane, weights duplicated across both float lanes
